title: silver barrier spam READ DESCRIPTION
features:
Heres the steps:
1) You MUST choose silver at the selection screen. 
2) When you are spawned in as silver, execute the script.
3) Then, the script spams barriers at your character position. In return, you turn into a minion. 
I highly recommend using noclip with this.
